hook: Questions that made us fall in love all over again 💞
slide2: What was your first impression of me — honestly?
slide3: When did you know this was serious?
slide4: What's a memory of us you replay in your head?
slide5: What do I do that makes you feel safe?
slide6: What's something about me you'd never change?
slide7: What do you want us to be like in 10 years?
cta: Send this to your person and answer #5 💌

hook: What to ask after an argument (that actually helps)
slide2: What did you need from me in that moment?
slide3: What did I say that hurt the most?
slide4: What do you think I was really upset about?
slide5: Is there anything you still need to say?
slide6: What can we do differently next time?
slide7: Are we okay? (Ask it. Mean it.)
cta: Save this for the next hard conversation 🤍

hook: Totally ridiculous questions to ask your partner 😂
slide2: If I were a vegetable which one would I be?
slide3: Would you still love me if I was a worm?
slide4: What would our couple name be as a band?
slide5: Which cartoon character am I most like?
slide6: If we were robbers what would our crime be?
slide7: What's my most annoying habit — in one word?
cta: Send this to your partner and screenshot their answers 😂
